name: Claude Agent SDK
description: Lets Python and TypeScript developers embed the Claude Code agent loop in their apps, with built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, and resumable sessions.

skills.name: Built-In Tools
skills.description: Gives the agent Claude Code's tools to read, write, and edit files, run commands, and search the web.

skills.name: Hooks
skills.description: Runs your callbacks on agent events such as tool calls or session start to block or modify behavior.

skills.name: Subagents
skills.description: Spawns separate agent instances for focused subtasks with isolated context, optionally in parallel.

skills.name: MCP Integration
skills.description: Connects the agent to external tools and data sources through Model Context Protocol servers.

skills.name: Sessions
skills.description: Persists conversation history to disk so an agent can resume or fork a session with full context.
